subject.title: [Bug] Dreaming narrative: hardcoded 60s timeout includes lane-queue wait; timeout disposal aborts the primary call then discards the successful fallback-model output

question: What public memory-core Dream Diary timeout and cleanup contract should maintainers accept for #101603?
rationale: The bug is credible from source and release evidence, but exposing `dreaming.execution.*`, changing timeout accounting, and changing timeout cleanup semantics are public bundled-plugin behavior decisions that overlap open timeout and no-text issues.

options.title: Broader narrative contract
options.body: Define one contract covering timeout config, queue/execution deadline semantics, and late-output cleanup, then update manifest, runtime, docs, and tests together.

options.title: Timeout-only first
options.body: Refresh the open timeout-config PR as a narrow step and keep queue-time attribution plus late-output cleanup tracked separately.

options.title: Internal runtime fix only
options.body: Fix queue-time accounting and timeout cleanup without adding new public Dream Diary config surface.

recommendation.title: Broader narrative contract
recommendation.body: Define one contract covering timeout config, queue/execution deadline semantics, and late-output cleanup, then update manifest, runtime, docs, and tests together.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent memory-core SDK seam work makes this the best available routing candidate for the config/runtime boundary decision.
